prompt: This is a scene showcasing the rural scenery. There is a wet wooden boardwalk in the picture, winding through colorful flowers, among which various bright flowers such as pink and orange bloom. Beside the boardwalk are staggered terraced fields, lush with greenery. In the distance are several traditional style wooden houses with black roofs, distributed among the mountains. In the background, the mountains stretch endlessly, with clouds and mist swirling around them, giving people a peaceful, serene, and poetic feeling, as if it is a paradise away from the hustle and bustle. This kind of rural landscape is common in the mountainous areas of southern China, blending natural beauty with traditional architectural styles, reflecting the artistic conception of harmonious coexistence between humans and nature. --ar 2:3 --stylize 250 --v 6.1
